problems.title: Angle between two straight-line graphs
problems.question: Find the smaller angle between $y=5x-2$ and $y=3x+1$.
problems.idea: Use the standard formula with all domain, orientation and geometric conditions checked.
steps: The tangent is $|2/16|=1/8$, so $\theta=\arctan(1/8)$.

problems.title: A tangent intercept gives a derivative ratio
problems.question: A line through $(1,0)$ is tangent to $y=f(x)$ at abscissa 3. Find $f(3)/f\prime(3)$.
problems.idea: Use the standard formula with all domain, orientation and geometric conditions checked.
steps: The line through $(1,0),(3,f(3))$ has slope $f(3)/(3-1)=f(3)/2$.
Thus $f\prime(3)=f(3)/2$ and the requested ratio is 2.
problems.note: The stated unique x-axis intercept excludes a tangent coincident with the whole x axis, in which the ratio would be undefined.

problems.title: Two tangents from a point on the vertical axis
problems.question: Tangents from a point $A$ on the $y$ axis to $y=(\sqrt3/2)x^2+\sqrt3/2$ form $60^\circ$. Find the listed point $A$.
problems.idea: Use the standard formula with all domain, orientation and geometric conditions checked.
formulas: A tangent at $x=t$ has slope $m=\sqrt3t$ and vertical intercept $b=(\sqrt3/2)(1-t^2)$.
steps: The contact points are symmetric. For the tangent rays from $A$ to make $60^\circ$, each ray makes $60^\circ$ with the horizontal in its respective direction, so $m^2=3$.
Then $t^2=1$ and $b=0$, giving $A=(0,0)$, the listed answer.
problems.note: If “angle between tangents” means the smaller angle between undirected lines, A=(0,4√3/9) also works: slopes ±1/√3 give a 60° line angle but a 120° angle between the contact-point rays.

problems.title: Minimum of a quartic
problems.question: Find the minimum of $x^4-6x^2$.
problems.idea: Use the standard formula with all domain, orientation and geometric conditions checked.
steps: The square is nonnegative and vanishes at $x=\pm\sqrt3$. Thus the minimum is $-9$.

problems.title: Optimize a square prism with a fixed edge sum
problems.question: A regular square prism’s twelve edges total 12. Maximize lateral area plus one base area.
problems.idea: Use the standard formula with all domain, orientation and geometric conditions checked.
formulas: For base side $s$ and height $h$, $8s+4h=12$ and objective $4sh+s^2$.
steps: $h=3-2s$, with $0<s<3/2$. The objective becomes $12s-7s^2=36/7-7(s-6/7)^2$.
The maximum is $36/7$ at $s=6/7,h=9/7$, both valid positive lengths.

problems.title: Undo a reflection with a reflection
problems.question: $f$ reflects in $y=2x+1$. Which reflection $g$ makes $g\circ f$ the identity?
problems.idea: Use the standard formula with all domain, orientation and geometric conditions checked.
formulas: A reflection is its own inverse.
steps: Apply the same reflection twice: every point returns to its starting position. Therefore $g$ must be reflection in the same line.

problems.title: Horizontal tangents of a quartic
problems.question: How many points on $y=x^4+x^3+x^2+7$ have horizontal tangents?
problems.idea: Use the standard formula with all domain, orientation and geometric conditions checked.
formulas: A horizontal tangent requires derivative zero.
steps: The quadratic factor has discriminant $9-32=-23<0$ and never vanishes. Only $x=0$ gives a horizontal tangent.

problems.title: Tangent to the exponential graph
problems.question: Find the tangent to $y=e^x$ at $(1,e)$.
problems.idea: Use the standard formula with all domain, orientation and geometric conditions checked.
steps: The slope is $e$. Thus $y-e=e(x-1)$, simplifying to $y=ex$.

problems.title: Find a homothety centre
problems.question: A scale-2 homothety takes $(2,2)$ to $(3,3)$. Find its centre $K$.
problems.idea: Use the standard formula with all domain, orientation and geometric conditions checked.

problems.title: Locate a decreasing argument
problems.question: Which listed input lies in a decreasing interval of $f(x)=x+4/x+2$?
problems.idea: Use the standard formula with all domain, orientation and geometric conditions checked.
steps: The derivative is negative exactly when $0<|x|<2$, giving intervals $(-2,0),(0,2)$.
Of the listed inputs, only $-1$ belongs to them.

problems.title: Minimum on the positive half-line
problems.question: Find the minimum of $x+4/x+2$ for $x>0$.
problems.idea: Use the standard formula with all domain, orientation and geometric conditions checked.
steps: Adding 2 gives a lower bound 6. Equality is attained when $x=4/x$, hence $x=2$.

problems.title: An oblique asymptote
problems.question: Find the oblique asymptote of $y=x+4/x+2$.
problems.idea: Use the standard formula with all domain, orientation and geometric conditions checked.
formulas: If $f(x)-(mx+b)\to0$ at infinity, $y=mx+b$ is an oblique asymptote.
steps: Subtract $x+2$ to get $4/x$, which tends to zero at both infinities.

problems.title: Rotate a point through one hundred twenty degrees
problems.question: Rotate $(1,\sqrt3)$ counterclockwise by $120^\circ$ about the origin.
problems.idea: Use the standard formula with all domain, orientation and geometric conditions checked.
formulas: The point has radius 2 and polar angle $60^\circ$.
steps: The new angle is $60^\circ+120^\circ=180^\circ$. The new point is $(2\cos180^\circ,2\sin180^\circ)=(-2,0)$.

problems.title: Perpendicular planes from their normals
problems.question: Find the angle between $5x-2y+3z+2=0$ and $x+y-z=0$.
problems.idea: Use the standard formula with all domain, orientation and geometric conditions checked.
formulas: Plane angle equals the smaller angle between their normals.
steps: The normals are $(5,-2,3)$ and $(1,1,-1)$, with dot product $5-2-3=0$. They are perpendicular.

problems.title: Maximum-volume cone with fixed slant height
problems.question: Among cones of slant height 3, find the height giving greatest volume.
problems.idea: Use the standard formula with all domain, orientation and geometric conditions checked.
steps: On $0<h<3$, the derivative is $(\pi/3)(9-3h^2)$, vanishing at $h=\sqrt3$.
It is positive before this point and negative afterward; the endpoint limiting volumes are zero. Thus this is the global maximum.

problems.title: A tangent passing through an extra point
problems.question: For which $p$ does the tangent to $y=x^3-px$ at $x=1$ pass through $(2,3)$?
problems.idea: Use the standard formula with all domain, orientation and geometric conditions checked.
steps: At $x=2$, the tangent ordinate is $(1-p)+(3-p)=4-2p$. Set it equal to 3.
Thus $p=1/2$.

problems.title: Combine logarithms while keeping a sign restriction
problems.question: Solve $\log_2(-x)+\log_2(x^2)=1$.
problems.idea: Use the standard formula with all domain, orientation and geometric conditions checked.
formulas: The domain requires $x<0$; the sum is $\log_2(-x^3)$.
steps: $-x^3=2$ gives $x=-\sqrt[3]2$. This lies in the domain and is the unique real solution.

problems.title: A tetrahedron cut off by a plane
problems.question: Find the volume bounded by the coordinate planes and $6x-5y+10z-30=0$.
problems.idea: Use the standard formula with all domain, orientation and geometric conditions checked.
formulas: For three axis intercepts $a,b,c$, tetrahedron volume is $|abc|/6$.
steps: The intercepts are $x=5,y=-6,z=3$. Their absolute product is 90, so the volume is $90/6=15$.

problems.title: Distance between parallel planes
problems.question: Find the distance between $6x-2y+3z-1=0$ and $6x-2y+3z+20=0$.
problems.idea: Use the standard formula with all domain, orientation and geometric conditions checked.
steps: The constant difference is 21 and normal length $\sqrt{36+4+9}=7$. Thus the distance is 3.

problems.title: Count integer exponents
problems.question: How many integer $x$ satisfy $1.99<2^x<199$?
problems.idea: Use the standard formula with all domain, orientation and geometric conditions checked.
steps: $2^0=1$ is too small, while $2^1=2$ works. $2^7=128$ works and $2^8=256$ is too large.
The integer exponents are 1 through 7.

problems.title: Add two logarithmic exponents
problems.question: $9^a=63$ and $3^b=1/\sqrt7$. Find $a+b$.
problems.idea: Use the standard formula with all domain, orientation and geometric conditions checked.
steps: The logarithmic parts cancel, leaving 1.

problems.title: Order reciprocal logarithms and a small power
problems.question: Order $a=\log_25,b=\log_52,c=199^{-199}$ increasingly.
problems.idea: Use the standard formula with all domain, orientation and geometric conditions checked.
steps: In fact $a<3$, so $b>1/3$. Meanwhile $0<c<1/199<1/3$.
Therefore $c<b<a$.

problems.title: Length of a coordinate altitude
problems.question: $A=(1,1),B=(3,7),C=(5,5)$. Find the altitude from $B$ to $AC$.
problems.idea: Use the standard formula with all domain, orientation and geometric conditions checked.
steps: Line $AC$ is $y=x$. The distance from $B$ is $|3-7|/\sqrt2=2\sqrt2$.

problems.title: Cylinder radius from volume and axial area
problems.question: A cylinder has volume $36\pi$ and axial-section area 8. Find its radius.
problems.idea: Use the standard formula with all domain, orientation and geometric conditions checked.
steps: From $2rh=8$, $rh=4$. The volume equation becomes $r(rh)=36$, so $4r=36$ and $r=9$.

problems.title: A tangent with inclination forty-five degrees
problems.question: On $y=x^3-2x^2+2x-4$, which listed abscissa can have a tangent inclined $45^\circ$ to the positive $x$ direction?
problems.idea: Use the standard formula with all domain, orientation and geometric conditions checked.
steps: The valid abscissas are $1/3$ and 1. Only 1 is listed.
problems.answer: $x=1$ among the choices; the other possible abscissa is $1/3$.
